//: Capability manifest for <ProfilePanel> — svelte-pure-admin. See card.map.json for the model. `name`/`email` are REQUIRED string props flowing through to the inline header. `noAvatar` maps to hasAvatar with `negate` (hasAvatar=false → __header--no-avatar). The item-level nav/favorites classes are the deferred sub-components (ProfilePanelNavItem / ProfilePanelFavorites / ProfilePanelFavoriteItem), not covered by this container+header slice.
